chapter: New Orleans clubs and Sharky's band
title: Speakeasies and Major Myron Weisham
summary: Played many speakeasies with Tony; what they were like; the police drinking there and Major Weisham.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: I never was offered a job like that, if I remember correctly. Now, I played an awful lot of speakeasies, Tony and I did together.
Now, was that really like they show it in the movies? You have to come to the door and knock?
Would they let me in if I went?
No, if they didn't know your face, unless you was with someone that they did know.
Were you ever in one when it got raided?
No. The police came out, but they never did raid. They came out to drink. Did you ever know Major Myron Weisham?
